key_insight: Quantum Broker distributes a circuit’s measurement shots across heterogeneous QPUs to meet user-defined quality-of-service constraints and objectives.
engineering_relevance: Its provider-agnostic execution layer helps engineers manage cost, latency, fidelity, and reproducibility across fragmented quantum cloud platforms.
method: Exploit statistically independent measurement shots to split execution across QPUs.
Express QoS requirements with QQSpec and characterize backends through interchangeable profiling strategies.
Optimize shot allocations using MILP or nonlinear dual-annealing solvers.
evidence_signal: Benchmark-circuit experiments on noisy simulators produced feasible QoS-aware plans and improved QoS satisfaction over single-backend and naive multi-backend baselines.
watch_item: Real-hardware validation remains important; the nonlinear solver improved allocation quality but required more planning time.
paper_title: Quantum Broker: QoS-Aware Distribution of Quantum Computations
